claims.statement: Repository toolchain requires Node >=24 and pnpm >=10, pins pnpm 11.25.0 via packageManager with Corepack activation, and runs scheduled wiki CI on Node 24.
All pnpm wiki:* scripts preload scripts/openwiki-fetch-patch.mjs via node --import before invoking the pinned openwiki 0.7.2 CLI, with wiki:update:print as the non-interactive command CI runs.

Inference must use OPENWIKI_PROVIDER=openai-compatible against https://opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1 with model muse-spark-1.3-contributor and OPENWIKI_OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_USE_RESPONSES_API=true; false routes to /chat/completions and fails as ModelProtocolUnsupported surfaced as HTTP 401.

scripts/openwiki-fetch-patch.mjs injects mandatory x-opencode-session ses_32-hex header only for opencode.ai requests, reusing OPENWIKI_OPENCODE_SESSION_ID override when valid, deriving a deterministic per-run hash in GitHub Actions, generating a random value locally, and never overwriting an existing header.

Scheduled wiki CI triggers daily at 08:00 UTC plus workflow_dispatch, checks out full git history so openwiki code --update can diff, installs with frozen lockfile, and runs code --update --print with continue-on-error to preserve partial pages.

Wiki CI produces docs-only PRs limited to openwiki, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md when present, excludes workflow-file changes and transient openwiki/.run.json, and squash-merges with --admin on success because auto-merge would wait on the required code-owner review.

Secrets are never committed: local runs use untracked .env copied from .env.example, CI maps OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY secret to OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY, and PR creation and merge require dedicated OPENWIKI_PR_TOKEN with Contents and Pull requests write because default GITHUB_TOKEN does not trigger pull_request workflows.

Submission layout requires repository with README, .env.example, AGENTS.md, data loader and transform scripts without large re-downloadable files, semantic dictionary, policies RBAC and masking, skills, evals questions and EX grader plus runner, and docs diagrams, plus technical report, ownership table, at most 15-minute demo video, and one sample trace per UC; the harness implements the data contract in packages/data/src with publisher cache and seeded signals kept out of the wiki index.

PRD allows Python (recommended) or TypeScript with LangGraph (recommended) or a justified equivalent, and the implemented harness uses TypeScript with LangGraph.js plus MCP and Postgres 16 with pgvector.

Coding agents must treat generated wiki as optional just-in-time context with source as authoritative, respect the .openwikiignore read boundary including data dumps and secrets, and prefer updating source over hand-editing generated pages.

Root quality gate is pnpm typecheck (tsc -b over seven tsconfig.json project references with strict ESM nodenext base), pnpm lint (eslint . with no-restricted-imports guards on agent, access-policy, api, and web), and pnpm test (tsc -b plus vitest run over contracts, agent, mcp-server, access-policy, data, api, and web projects).
pnpm docs:interface regenerates docs/mcp_interface.md from frozen @shared/contracts Zod schemas via tsx scripts/generate-interface.mjs and the output must never be hand-edited.

pnpm-workspace.yaml declares pnpm v11 build approvals for better-sqlite3, esbuild, and @launchql/protobufjs, defines the apps/* and packages/* workspace globs, and holds the shared catalog that workspace packages must reference via catalog:.

Harness operator entrypoints are pnpm db:up and db:reset for the loopback database, pnpm data:load with full one-million-order_items default and --scale=small CI variant sharing the same FK graph, pnpm data:verify pinning each scale to its own seed manifest, plus pnpm demo:tracer, pnpm eval, pnpm skills:check, and pnpm external-client.

The database is Postgres 16 plus pgvector bound loopback-only on 127.0.0.1:5433 with pgdata and initdb volumes and a pg_isready healthcheck; committed dev-default passwords must match docker initdb roles and must never leave loopback development.

Gateway authorization uses per-role bearer tokens resolved through tokenEnv names in policies/mcp_clients.yaml with scope and row-scope predicates, while sensitive columns customers phone, email, address and employees salary are rewritten or blocked before execution and PII is redacted in outputs and traces.

Adding a workspace package is an extension seam requiring catalog: references for shared dependencies, tsconfig project-reference coverage, workspace:* links and dist entrypoints, and extension of the enumerated ESLint no-restricted-imports guards so the new package cannot silently bypass DB and contract boundaries.

General CI splits the root gate into typecheck, lint, policy with check:workspace and skills:check, unit test, docs interface-drift, live-database with small load plus verify plus role and gateway live tests, and gitleaks secrets jobs behind one required gate check for branch protection.

Workspace invariants pin CONTRACTS_VERSION to the packages/contracts package version so additive contract changes need one code-owner review and breaking changes need a major bump plus agreement from affected owners.

skills:check fails on any executable file under skills/ and on key blocks, URLs, or DSN strings, validates eight canonical declarative-skill headings when skills exist, and passes with a no-skills-yet message otherwise.

pnpm demo:tracer proves the full gateway pipeline from bearer-token auth through scope, zod, sqlGuard, AccessPolicy, executor, PII scan, and audit over Streamable HTTP without shortcuts and asserts seven PII-clean trace events.
